skill.name: monorepo-architect
skill.description: Guides monorepo architecture, tool selection, build caching, dependency graphs, and CI optimization for multi-project repositories.
skill.summary: Design and optimize scalable monorepos with clear structure, caching, and dependency rules.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Large repositories become slow when structure, dependencies, and build pipelines are not planned. This skill helps teams design faster monorepo workflows.
actual_capabilities: Compares Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, and Lerna for repository needs.
Designs workspace structure and project boundaries for multiple applications.
Recommends local and remote build caching strategies.
Plans dependency graph rules, tags, and ownership boundaries.
Defines affected-change detection for faster CI pipelines.
Outlines task orchestration and parallel execution workflows.
limitations: It provides architectural guidance but does not execute migrations automatically.
It needs repository details to make tool recommendations accurate.
It cannot validate performance claims without project metrics.
It does not replace security review of custom build scripts.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Monorepo
use_cases.description: Choose a tool, define project boundaries, and set early conventions for a new multi-team repository.

use_cases.title: Migrate from Polyrepos
use_cases.description: Create a staged migration plan that keeps ownership, releases, and CI predictable during consolidation.

use_cases.title: Speed Up CI
use_cases.description: Design caching, affected-change detection, and task pipelines to reduce unnecessary builds and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Monorepo Tool
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose between Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, and Lerna. My teams build [apps], use [languages], and need [CI goals].

prompt_templates.title: Design Workspace Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this planned monorepo structure: [structure]. Recommend project boundaries, shared libraries, naming rules, and ownership conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Build Pipelines
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this CI workflow: [workflow summary]. Propose caching, affected-change detection, and task orchestration improvements for a monorepo.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased migration plan from these repositories: [repo list]. Include risks, sequencing, dependency strategy, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: We have three web apps, two shared packages, and slow CI.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend a workspace layout, shared package boundaries, caching strategy, and affected-change workflow for faster builds.

output_examples.input: We want to move ten services into one repository.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a phased migration plan with ownership rules, dependency controls, release considerations, and rollback checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Our monorepo builds every project on each pull request.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest affected-project detection, remote cache usage, task pipelines, and metrics to verify CI improvement.

best_practices: Share repository size, languages, package managers, and CI constraints before asking for tool recommendations.
Define ownership and dependency rules before moving many projects into one workspace.
Measure build times before and after cache or pipeline changes.
anti_patterns: Do not choose a monorepo tool only because it is popular.
Do not create shared libraries without clear ownership and release expectations.
Do not enable remote caching without access controls and cache invalidation rules.

faq.question: Can this skill choose the best monorepo tool for my team?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares tools against your repository size, language stack, CI needs, and team workflow.

faq.question: Does it support Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, and Lerna?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly covers those tools for architecture and workflow planning.

faq.question: Can it migrate repositories automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can create a migration plan, but implementation still requires engineering work.

faq.question: Can it help reduce CI build time?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend caching, affected-change detection, and task orchestration strategies.

faq.question: Is this skill useful for small teams?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help small teams avoid early structure and dependency mistakes.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide repository goals, project count, languages, package managers, CI workflow, and current pain points.
